explanation: All 25 points (W=1.6 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0) passed preflight and were generated as full O(alpha) (rc_mode='full') input files, auto-chunked into 3 files (10+10+5). Two warnings: (1) phi goes 0..345 in 15-degree steps, which is 24 unique values; the 25th point is phi=0 again (a duplicate at the same kinematics); this is harmless but will produce a redundant computation. (2) Beam energy was not explicitly requested, so the channel default of 6.53 GeV (CLAS12 RG-K) was used. Alternative CLAS12 energies 10.6 or 10.2 GeV are available but give different radiative corrections. vcut defaulted to 0.166 GeV^2.
